name: lazy-summer-japanese-film-girl
image_vibe: Lazy Japanese summer film, soft morning light, faded colors, intimate distant calm
image_purpose: Create a sleepy unposed indoor summer moment with authentic negative-film texture.

prompt.project_info: A 2:3 Japanese negative-film portrait of a quiet summer morning indoors.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman lying casually on an unmade bed, body slightly curled or stretched, hair naturally spread, one arm resting on her forehead or partly covering her face, and a relaxed sleepy expression. She wears loose, fully opaque sleepwear or casual clothing.
prompt.composition_elements: Unmade bed details, natural fabric wrinkles, imperfect off-center composition, and an intimate but non-posed environmental portrait.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft morning light with slight highlight overexposure, low contrast, muted faded colors, subtle bloom, gentle grain, and quiet distant summer mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 2:3 portrait composition, Japanese negative-film aesthetic, realistic skin texture without heavy retouching, subtle analog grain, natural candid rendering.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 2:3 Japanese negative-film portrait of an original adult woman lying casually on an unmade bed in a lazy summer indoor scene. Her body is slightly curled or stretched, hair naturally spread, one arm resting on her forehead, and her expression relaxed and sleepy. Dress her in loose fully opaque sleepwear or casual clothing. Include fabric wrinkles and imperfect off-center framing; use soft morning light, slight highlight overexposure, low contrast, muted faded colors, gentle bloom, realistic texture, and subtle analog grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent sleepwear, exposed underwear, nudity, seductive posing, excessive retouching, plastic skin, harsh contrast, distorted anatomy, watermark, text

assets.name: source lazy-summer film reference
assets.usage: Use only for pose, room atmosphere, light, and film treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the sleepy summer indoor concept and negative-film mood. Keep the subject original adult and clothing fully opaque.
